title: Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A classic Argentine dish featuring marinated beef skewers grilled to perfection, served with a side of chimichurri sauce. This recipe is perfect for a summer barbecue or outdoor gathering.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together orange juice, garlic, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add beef cubes to the marinade and mix well.
4. Thread beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush grill with oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
7. Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
8. Serve with chimichurri sauce for dipping.
